Final square inventory/shop item icon for a ninja fantasy RPG: the "Basic Harvest Kama", a practical shinobi harvesting sickle. Hand-painted high-quality fantasy RPG inventory illustration with dimensional painterly shading, crisp bevel highlights and realistic material texture, readable at 64 pixels.
Subject: ONE Japanese kama sickle. A short crescent-curved forged steel blade with a sharp inner cutting edge, a faint hamon line and subtle wear, set at a right angle into the top of a straight wooden handle. The handle is wrapped in black cloth cord in a diamond pattern and ends in a small iron ring pommel. Tied to the ring with a short loop of tan braided cord hangs a small woven reed gathering satchel, closed with a toggle, with one green herb sprig peeking out. Restrained common-tier design, no magic glow.
Composition: the handle runs diagonally from lower left up toward the upper right, the curved blade at the top right curling back over the handle; the small satchel hangs at the lower right, smaller than the blade. Whole object visible, clean outer silhouette, about 6% empty margin, no cropping.
Lighting: soft warm upper-left key light, cool steel reflections, readable contact shading within the object.
Background: fully transparent background, isolated object, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no card, no vignette, no border. No text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no hands, no people.

Hand-painted side-view landscape backdrop for a ninja harvesting minigame in a fantasy RPG. Eye-level view across a quiet terraced herb meadow at the edge of an old Japanese forest in late afternoon. Background: soft misty layered mountains, tall cedar trees and a few maple trees with warm autumn leaves on the left and right edges, a small weathered stone lantern half hidden in the grass at the far right edge. Middle ground: gentle rolling grass terraces with low stone retaining walls. Foreground: a long flat strip of dark rich tilled soil and short trimmed grass running across the whole width of the bottom 30% of the frame, completely clear and open so game plants can be drawn standing on it. The center 70% of the frame above the soil strip is open sky and soft distant scenery with nothing tall in it. Warm golden sidelight, gentle haze, subtle drifting pollen. Painterly, detailed, atmospheric, matches a hand-painted RPG art style. Landscape 3:2 composition. No people, no animals, no tools, no weapons, no tall plants or stalks in the center foreground, no text, no lettering, no logos, no interface, no border.
